{{Infobox Form
|quote=<translate><!--T:1--> Unleash your power to the limit: Ultimate takes the multipliers of your strongest form and adds a bonus.</translate>
|Race=<translate><!--T:2--> Every race</translate>
|Group=<translate><!--T:3--> Ultimate (1 tier)</translate>
|Form type=<translate><!--T:4--> Stack form</translate>
|Requirements=<translate><!--T:5--> Clear Old Kai's Ultimate Challenge (alignment above 61, Potential Unlock level 10)</translate>
|Multiplier=<translate><!--T:6--> Your best unlocked form +1.0 STR, SKP and PWR</translate>

}}
<translate>
<!--T:9-->
'''Ultimate''' is a stack form unlocked by [[Special:MyLanguage/Old Kai|Old Kai]]. Unlike [[Special:MyLanguage/Kaioken|Kaioken]], it isn't used on top of another form: it takes the multipliers of your '''best unlocked form''' (with its mastery) and adds '''+1.0''' to its STR, SKP and PWR multipliers, with '''no drain'''. It can't be bought with Training Points.
</translate>

<translate>
== Unlocking Ultimate == <!--T:10-->
</translate>
{{See also|Old Kai|Training Minigames}}
<translate>
<!--T:11-->
With an '''alignment above 61''' and '''Potential Unlock level 10''', talk to Old Kai at his pillar on the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sacred Kai Planet|Sacred Kai Planet]] and choose '''Unleash Power''' to start the '''Ultimate Challenge''': five training minigames back to back ([[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]], Gravity, Shadow Boxing, Precision and Rhythm), each until you clear its target level (10 levels, 6 for Rhythm). Clearing all five:

<!--T:12-->
* unlocks the '''Ultimate''' skill;
* gives you the [[Special:MyLanguage/Z Sword|Z Sword]], only the first time you complete it.

<!--T:13-->
Both are needed for the [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]] quest ''The Z Sword and Ultimate Power'', which asks you to reach Ultimate level 1.
</translate>

<translate>
== How it works == <!--T:14-->

<!--T:15-->
* Ultimate copies the multipliers of your '''best unlocked form''', with that form's mastery, and adds '''+1.0''' to its STR, SKP and PWR multipliers. It has '''no drain'''.
* Each race's '''top tier''' is never copied: SSJ 4, Solaris, Super Namekian, Fifth Form, Ultra Majin, Ultra Perfect and True Form. Ultimate uses your best form below it.
* Ultimate has no mastery of its own: it charges, and transforms instantly, as fast as the form it copies.
</translate>

<translate>
== Configuration == <!--T:16-->
</translate>
{{Config|General Server Config|ultimateFormFixedValue}}
<translate>
<!--T:17-->
With <code>ultimateFormFixedValue</code> set to <code>true</code>, Ultimate stops copying your best form and only uses the multipliers written in its own form file (×2.0 STR, SKP and PWR and ×1.1875 DEF by default). The Ultimate form is defined in <code>config/dragonminez/forms/ultimate.json</code>.
</translate>
{{See also|Custom Forms|Transformations}}
